newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Astra ups profit forecast, to float units.
newsitem.headline: Astra ups profit forecast, to float units.

text.p: Indonesia's largest automobile manufacturer Astra International on Wednesday forecast its 1997 net profit at 627 billion rupiah against 470 billion rupiah in 1996.

Astra Finance Director Rini Suwandi told reporters after the company's annual shareholders meeting that the forecast was based on good sales of its Kijang four-wheel drive vehicles and strong demand for its motorcycles.

Suwandi also said the company planned to float three of its subsidiaries. The banking and plantations units would be listed on the exchange later this year while the auto parts subsidiary would be floated in February 1998, she said.

Wholly-owned unit Bank Universal would be floated in September, Suwandi said. Between 20 and 25 percent of the equity would be offered to public and the company expected to raise 105 billion rupiah, she said.
In October, Astra planned to float shares in PT Astra Agro, a subsidiary managing plantations, she said. Some 200-250 billion rupiah would be raised from the float.
Auto components unit PT Astra Dian Lestari would be floated in February 1998, and the company estimated it would raise 300 billion rupiah from the sale of shares, Suwandi said.
